thesis: This episode argues that high-quality companies are defined by exceptional operating models, the ability to raise prices while maintaining goodwill, and successful execution of turnarounds. It highlights specific examples like RH, Costco, and Amazon as businesses that have transformed or pushed market limits to generate high margins, while noting that not all companies with high valuations possess these same durable characteristics.
